notes: Demo-available melee gear: scimitars, swords, mallets, the Bone Scythe, and all armour slots (helmets, torsos, legs, boots, gloves, capes, amulets, rings and offhand defenders/shields) with equip requirements, combat stats, Smithing recipes and drop sources. Defenders live in the armour list because they use the Defence skill and compete for the offhand slot. Mallets are two-handed: they occupy the offhand slot and cannot use a defender. The client also contains artwork for additional tiers that are not in the Demo 0.11.2 item database; they are listed under future_tiers.
